cohort: Parturients who delivered at a teaching hospital in Southern Brazil, between May and August 2018
finding: Maternal age, family history of type 2 diabetes, obesity, and pregestational overweightness were significantly associated with a higher chance of developing gestational diabetes.
mod_finding: There was no significant difference in delivery route between parturients with and without a gestational diabetes diagnosis.
birth_weight: Mean birth weight was significantly higher in infants of mothers diagnosed with diabetes.
